label: flows into waterbody
definition: River or watercourse X flows into, joins, or empties into receiving waterbody Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit flow-into or empty-into; river confluence with an identified receiving waterbody; river meeting Y when direction is locally clear. Excludes: ordinary interpersonal meeting or joint action; adjacency or a waterfront gateway alone; flow in the reverse direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: a bare meet or join with unresolved receiving direction; unclear watercourse versus place name. Direction is upstream tributary or river to receiving waterbody; confluence alone must identify direction locally.

facts.reason: Rondout Creek → Hudson: Explicit flow-into or empty-into paths establish the river-to-receiving-waterbody direction, resolving the accompanying meet and join paths.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
